disposition.how_E_is_qualified: E's clause 'representation comparison is unresolved' is too strong for what was measured and is explicitly narrowed here. The ADMISSION half is cleanly resolved and structurally informative: on the one non-admission class that habitat coincidence cannot settle, B beats the matched scramble C by 0.636904761905 with a 95% CI of [0.565476190476, 0.705357142857], sign-consistent across 14 folds, while the structure-preserving relabeling D matches B (-0.011904761905). That pattern supports H_struct and H_equiv on admission. It does not support H_suff for the full relation, because forcing fails.
disposition.opaque_token_recommendation: NOT warranted yet. The deferred discovery stage asks whether a learner can recover an SFP-equivalent representation from opaque tokens. That question only becomes measurable once being HANDED the exact code suffices for the task, and here it does not: Arm B is handed the exact certified code and still cannot name the held-out forced third. Hiding the code behind opaque tokens would make a strictly harder version of an already-failing task and could not discriminate. The prerequisite is to first close the forcing gap under a supplied code.
disposition.primary_disposition_text: E - no arm supports genuine held-out relational generalization under the common learner on the full admit-and-force task

repair_accounting.motivation: harness.py demonstrated held-out target suppression: on a held-out-habitat fold the correct forced third is itself a held-out Event, scored as a candidate during training but never the right answer, so cross-entropy suppresses exactly the slots the test set needs
repair_accounting.outcome: TESTED AND INSUFFICIENT. It raises forced-third accuracy on the primary family but leaves it at the floor in absolute terms, so it changes no qualitative conclusion. Reported rather than iterated on: the stop rule permits exactly one repair and searching for a second after seeing results would be tuning.

supported_hypotheses.H_discovery: Deliberately not tested; deferred by design.
supported_hypotheses.H_equiv: SUPPORTED on admission: D matches B under GL(3,2) + affine AGL(2,2) + global S flip, so the admission result is not a basis artifact.
supported_hypotheses.H_exec: Already established upstream by Outcome 021.05; not retested.
supported_hypotheses.H_realization: SUPPORTED on admission in a direction the task did not single out: native realization did not merely fail to add advantage, it performed at chance on admission while the compact code did not.
supported_hypotheses.H_struct: SUPPORTED on admission: B >> C on the discriminating class with matched marginals, bit widths and habitat sizes, so the gain tracks relational alignment rather than code capacity.
supported_hypotheses.H_suff: NOT SUPPORTED for the full admit-and-force relation: forcing is at the floor. Partially supported for admission only.

disposition.why_E: The task is admit-AND-force, and forcing is unsolved by every representation. The nonlearned oracles name the forced third exactly (1.0) while the best learned arm reaches 0.033482142857. No arm therefore demonstrates held-out relational generalization of the certified relation as a whole.

fences: Correctness is exact certified Event identity, never float proximity.
Admission is reported as balanced accuracy and is a WEAK discriminator here: a cheaper-than-the-relation feature already reaches 0.921 (LOHO) and 0.958 (LOFPO).
Arm E is a diagnostic memorization ceiling, never a representation arm.
RANDOM_CONTROL was found non-dispositive by the Task 8 leakage search and is excluded from every disposition claim.
No post hoc equivalence margin; intervals and sign consistency instead.
One architecture plus one motivated repair, which was tested and reported.
issue: 009 - SFP consequence representation versus native FIPS realization

metric_policy.no_post_hoc_margin: no numeric equivalence margin is declared after the fact; paired bootstrap CIs and cross-fold sign consistency are reported instead
metric_policy.reading_caution: an arm that answers BOTTOM almost everywhere scores high on the non-admission classes and at chance on admission, so non-admission accuracy must always be read together with admission sensitivity
metric_policy.why: the Task 8 leakage search found that every relation-equivalent feature determines ADMISSION only; the best cheap subset reaches admission balanced accuracy 0.921 (LOHO) / 0.958 (LOFPO) while scoring 0.0 on forced third and 0.0 on SAME_HABITAT_DISJOINT. So forcing and the same-habitat-disjoint class carry the science and admission balanced accuracy does not.

pairing: every comparison differences LEFT - RIGHT over identical (fold, seed) cells, never across marginal means
